title: The 30 current arenas, public and private money

rows.owner: Capital Improvement Board of Marion County
rows.property_tax_status: CIB-owned; lease obliges CIB to pay any real property taxes (status not verified)
rows.notes_and_gaps: 1997A/B bond par ($230.7M), which the CIB says funded the construction of the Fieldhouse and an attached garage, exceeds the reported $183M cost and no primary public/private split was found, so the arena is counted as neither privately nor publicly built; the $79M public figure is press. CIB capital obligations under the 2014 and 2019 agreements (refresh, repairs, technology) from the CIB's notes; the 2010 and 2012 amendments' up to $3.5M not added. Ongoing CIB payments documented 2014-2025 (ACFR ten-year tables) and 2001.

rows.property_tax_status: City-owned; no property tax
rows.notes_and_gaps: Cost is a plan-of-finance figure (2016), not an audited final cost; the $12M of city cash repaid from Magic use payments is counted as private (team-repaid); interest earnings partly on the Magic's deposit (mixed).

rows.owner: District of Columbia (since 2024 purchase); Monumental leases
rows.property_tax_status: District-owned; $0 tax 2016-2026 on $524-528M assessment; OCFO values the continued exemption at ~$10.0M/yr (FY2026) and all relief in the 2024 law at $312.7M FY2025-2050
rows.notes_and_gaps: Building cost $175M (GAO, developer estimate) to $260M (press); 1997 public money from GAO (District $61.5M + $14M federal and WMATA for the Metro link); Monumental share of renovation computed from Council memo ($800M total).

rows.property_tax_status: City-owned; no property tax
rows.notes_and_gaps: City ACFR states a $200M project without itemizing it; the $170M public figure (press) is not split in any primary document; arena reserve contributions before FY2020 not reachable.

rows.owner: City of Memphis / Shelby County (Public Building Authority)
rows.property_tax_status: Publicly owned; no property tax
rows.notes_and_gaps: Cost and funding split from the City CAFR (FY2005); Sports Authority bond repayment streams not split (mixed); $470M of the $550M renovation pending lease.

rows.owner: Smith Entertainment Group (building); SLC Redevelopment/Community Reinvestment Agency (land)
rows.property_tax_status: Building taxable ($241.48M 2026); RDA land exempt with privilege tax account
rows.notes_and_gaps: 1990 RDA land value and any RDA cash not documented; 2017 city reimbursement counted at its $22.7M cap; district $375M in project row.

rows.property_tax_status: State-owned; no property tax
rows.notes_and_gaps: 1999 construction cost and mechanism from press; ongoing payments audited FY2003-FY2025 plus budgeted Quality Jobs equivalent FY2025-26 (FY2026 audit not issued); QJ FY2023-24, suite payments and home-game entitlements excluded.

rows.owner: Brooklyn Arena Local Development Corp. (state LDC) - leased to BSE (private)
rows.property_tax_status: Exempt (state LDC owns); PILOTs $39M (2023) service arena bonds; would-be tax $99M (IBO 2023); DOF FY2027 MV $2.54B
rows.notes_and_gaps: State $100M from press (Gotham Gazette); city $205M from IBO 2009 testimony; MTA rail yard counted at IBO's $10M arena share; PILOT bonds counted only in expanded total.

rows.property_tax_status: Owned by Gateway (public non-profit); taxable status not verified
rows.notes_and_gaps: Arena cost is the recorded building line, excluding the complex's shared land, site and capitalized costs; repayment source of the county's 1992 and 1994 arena bonds not documented (mixed); of the county's $140M of 2017 bonds, the $70M series the Cavaliers repay through added rent is counted as private, and the other $70M's repayment source is not documented (mixed).

rows.property_tax_status: County-owned; no property tax
rows.notes_and_gaps: Recorded cost probably includes capitalized interest; the 2000 bond program also paid for Coliseum and grounds work.

rows.property_tax_status: County-owned; no property tax
rows.notes_and_gaps: County land $37.6M from the Inspector General; construction cost $234.9M as capitalized by the county (ACFR), funded by the Heat; county payments $3.2M in FY2000 and $6.4M a year after, with FY2011-12 not documented and not counted; State of Florida payments after June 2014 at the scheduled rate.

rows.owner: Detroit Downtown Development Authority (public); Olympia operates
rows.property_tax_status: DDA-owned; exempt; Olympia operates rent-free (prior round)
rows.notes_and_gaps: Public share excludes DDA land/infrastructure outside bond-funded costs and the ongoing school-tax capture beyond debt service.

rows.property_tax_status: HCHSA-owned; no property tax
rows.notes_and_gaps: Final cost not found ($235M press; $195M floor from primary budgets); the city $20M for site and infrastructure is in the infrastructure bucket (no split); the Rockets' rent services a separate Rent Supported Debt issue (principal capped at $30.4M) whose share of construction was not found, so it is not netted; the 2026 renovation's expected $95M state grant is pending (no agreement found); 2020 rent abatements ($2.975M) and pre-opening maintenance deposits ($4.5M, payment unconfirmed) not counted.

rows.property_tax_status: City-owned; no property tax
rows.notes_and_gaps: 2002 cost from press; 2008 renovation arena share computed pro rata from plan; operating subsidy documented for FY2023 only; MAPS 4 money for the new arena reported as $70M, $78M, $89M and ~$99M.

rows.property_tax_status: WCD-owned; no property tax
rows.notes_and_gaps: Value of the Bradley Center site conveyed to the team not documented; state GPR to 2035-36 is debt service on counted bonds.

rows.property_tax_status: Publicly owned (Recreation Authority); no property tax (illustrative forgone tax $2.1-4.3M/yr at 1-2% of original cost, arena_prop)
rows.notes_and_gaps: Original construction split from Marquette summary (via search index) - Recreation Authority official statements not reachable (EMMA blocked).

rows.property_tax_status: City-owned; no property tax (possessory interest not verified)
rows.notes_and_gaps: Cost from the construction monitor's last posted report (99.5% complete), not an audited total; value of city parcels and billboard rights not documented.

rows.property_tax_status: City-owned; no property tax
rows.notes_and_gaps: 1992 cost and $35M city share from press; a 1998 arena refunding of $48.74M suggests more city debt; 2019 $175M includes the $25M renewal and replacement account paid over time.

rows.property_tax_status: City-owned; no property tax
rows.notes_and_gaps: City subsidy split (TIF bonds vs land and infrastructure) not settled (mixed); only 2024 operating supplements documented.

rows.property_tax_status: City-owned; no property tax
rows.notes_and_gaps: Construction cost and $125M public cap from press (Dallas Morning News 2006); 1998A/B arena bonds of $124.4M outstanding in 2002 (City ACFR) are consistent with the cap; the city's "more than $60 million" of infrastructure around Victory Park (press) is district-wide and not counted.

rows.owner: AEG (building); City of Los Angeles land (55-yr ground lease to 2053)
rows.property_tax_status: Land exempt (city-owned); AEG possessory-interest tax not visible in open data
rows.notes_and_gaps: City's ~$70M advance counted as public money: the developer's obligation is offset mainly by credits of city revenue (the arena admissions fee and convention center parking revenue); building cost from press; 1997 deal documents not reached.

rows.property_tax_status: City-owned since 2024 (no property tax; Allen paid ~$1.2M/yr before - WWeek); term sheet (Aug 12 2026): team pays rent $3.17M/yr (escalated by the lesser of CPI-W or 3%) and a property-tax offset payment of $3M/yr escalated 5%/yr
rows.notes_and_gaps: 1995 cost and city $34.5M from press, mechanism not documented; $573M rebuild pending; city match of team capital spending during the bridge term not quantified.

rows.property_tax_status: Building privately owned on city-owned land during a 23-year ground lease ($10 a year); property-tax increment paid back to the developer through DURA (the counted $36.5M TIF, repaid 2016)
rows.notes_and_gaps: Cost includes financing costs; construction sales-tax rebates under the 1997 agreement not quantified (its property-tax increment payments are the counted DURA TIF); seat-tax exemption estimated from one unverified press figure (memo only); land the city bought from Southern Pacific not found.

rows.property_tax_status: Taxable: FY2025-26 secured roll $1.645B (APN 8722-026 + units); est. tax $19.5M (a)
rows.notes_and_gaps: Building cost from press; public transit capital ($42.5M) is the SFMTA's 2015 plan, not an audited total; city event-day service costs not counted.

rows.property_tax_status: Taxable: FY2026 assessed $98.76M, gross tax $2,662,494 (Boston Assessing); approved in 1992 as a Chapter 121A project with negotiated payments ($1.0M a year rising to $1.5M) for the 15-year Chapter 121A term
rows.notes_and_gaps: No public construction money; as-built cost not found (the 1992 BRA estimate is used); the Chapter 121A tax arrangement and the deferred $5.126M MBTA note are not quantified.

rows.property_tax_status: Taxable; 2024 AV mailed $125.0M -> certified $92.1M -> BOR $50.3M; est. tax ~$10.4M (a); Treasurer: $10.8M paid in 2024 incl. the adjacent Advocate Center (b)
rows.notes_and_gaps: 1989 formula valuation counted in the expanded total for tax years 2002-2016 only; 1994-2001 inputs not reachable; last formula year inferred.

rows.property_tax_status: Taxable: 2026 roll ~$902M; est. tax ~$10.8M/yr (a)
rows.notes_and_gaps: No public money found; land purchased at $66.25M.

rows.property_tax_status: Exempt by state law since 1982; DOF: $42.4M forgone in FY2023, $43.3M in FY2026 (FY2023 FMV $867M)
rows.notes_and_gaps: Exemption: IBO (July 2023) estimates more than $946.7M in 2023 dollars forgone in FY1984-FY2023, converted to 2026 dollars, plus the Department of Finance's values for FY2024-FY2026; 1982-83 not estimated.

rows.arena: Xfinity Mobile Arena (formerly Wells Fargo Center)
rows.property_tax_status: Owner of record: City of Philadelphia (parcel 788020600, building code ARENA; city instruments to the Philadelphia Authority for Industrial Development in 2001); 2026 market value $253.2M, of which $249.5M exempt and $3.7M of land taxable; the exemption is worth about $3.49M a year at the 1.3998% rate (a); fully exempt in 2015-17. Not added to the expanded total: like other publicly owned arenas, it is public property
rows.notes_and_gaps: No public money found in sources reached (contemporaneous 1994-96 records not reached); the city is owner of record of the arena parcel, which is almost fully exempt from property tax (about $3.5M a year, not counted, as for other publicly owned arenas); renovation cost from press.

rows.property_tax_status: Private; Toronto property-tax status not verified
rows.notes_and_gaps: Cost from the owner's web page only; no Canadian public money documented; property-tax status not verified.

note: Private money is construction and renovation spending not paid by the public. Tax breaks are the Barclays Center PILOT bonds and the exemptions counted in the expanded total.
method: with m as ( select team, sum(public_2026_m) filter (where core) as public_2026_m, sum(spending_2026_m) filter (where core) as spending_2026_m, sum(public_2026_m) filter (where core and kind = 'construction') as construction_public_2026_m, sum(public_2026_m) filter (where core and kind = 'purchase') as purchase_public_2026_m, sum(public_2026_m) filter (where core and kind = 'renovation') as renovation_public_2026_m, sum(public_2026_m) filter (where core and kind = 'ongoing') as ongoing_public_2026_m, sum(public_2026_m) filter (where kind = 'renovation' and status = 'pending') as pending_2026_m from items where kind <> 'project' group by team) select a.team, a.arena, a.city, cast(a.opened as integer) as opened, a.owner, a.owner_type, a.built_privately_majority = 'Y' as built_private, a.built_privately_majority = 'unresolved' as split_unresolved, a.construction_cost_nominal_m, a.construction_cost_2026_m, a.construction_cost_label, m.public_2026_m, m.spending_2026_m, m.spending_2026_m - (m.public_2026_m - coalesce(m.purchase_public_2026_m, 0)) as private_2026_m, 100 * m.public_2026_m / m.spending_2026_m as public_share_pct, coalesce(m.construction_public_2026_m, 0) as construction_public_2026_m, coalesce(m.purchase_public_2026_m, 0) as purchase_public_2026_m, coalesce(m.renovation_public_2026_m, 0) as renovation_public_2026_m, coalesce(m.ongoing_public_2026_m, 0) as ongoing_public_2026_m, coalesce(m.pending_2026_m, 0) as pending_2026_m, coalesce(a.pilot_2026_m, 0) + case when a.tax_break_in_expanded_total = 'Y' then a.tax_break_cumulative_2026_m else 0 end as tax_breaks_2026_m, a.lease_end, a.property_tax_status, a.notes_and_gaps, coalesce((select list(s.source_id order by s.field, s.ord) from arena_sources s where s.row_type = 'current_arena' and s.team = a.team and s.field in ('construction_cost_source', 'public_construction_source', 'private_construction_source')), []) as sources from arenas a join m using (team) order by m.public_2026_m desc, a.team
